verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs describe channels, topics, search filters, and a bot API for building reactive bots, but none of this constitutes an AI-native natural-language command interface for operating the product itself — no evidence of NLU-driven commands, AI assistant, or agentic control layer. missing for 10: any natural-language command parsing/interface, AI assistant for operating Zulip, evidence of NL-driven actions beyond keyword search filters.
